scripts.install-hooks: H="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks"; cp .githooks/lib-runtime.sh .githooks/pre-push .githooks/post-commit .githooks/post-merge .githooks/pre-commit .githooks/secret-scan.mjs "$H"/ && chmod +x "$H"/pre-push "$H"/post-commit "$H"/post-merge "$H"/pre-commit && git config remote.origin.push refs/heads/publish:refs/heads/main && echo 'hooks installed; git push now deploys the runtime artifact'
